texts.zh: [From.GetName] 根本不是颗星球，而是个复杂的三维投影。它的中央是一个投影仪，生成一片能源场来逼真地模拟星球的实体与重力井，连我们的传感器都误以为它真的是颗星球，因此产生了异常的数据。我们只能猜测为何有人会特意在这个位置模拟一颗星球的存在。可惜的是，该投影仪在我们对它进行实验时被毁了。
texts.en: [From.GetName] is not a planet at all, but a sophisticated 3D projection. At its center is a projector that generates an energy field simulating a physical body and gravity well so convincingly that our sensors mistook it for an actual planet, producing the anomalous data. We can only speculate as to why someone would go to the trouble of faking the presence of a planetary body at this location. Sadly the projector did not survive our experimentation.

summary.text:
# 调查数据损坏 / Corrupt Survey Data

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：《遥远繁星》Distant Stars（has_distar） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/95_anomaly_categories_distant_stars.txt:1237-1263; events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:2469 (distar.1065)

## 如何开始 How it starts

需要《遥远繁星》。没有卫星、非盖亚、未在殖民、无特殊矿藏或考古遗址、不在帝国起始星团的宜居星球可能生成（4级，权重3，全局一次）。

Requires Distant Stars. Can spawn on a habitable planet without moons, not Gaia, not being colonised, without special deposits or an archaeological site and outside empire start clusters (level 4, weight 3, once per game).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

distar.1065“不存在的星球”：这颗“星球”只是一个精巧的三维投影，中心的投影仪模拟出实体和引力井，骗过了传感器；投影仪在实验中损坏。星球被从星图上移除，奖励工程学研究。

distar.1065 "The Planet That Wasn't There": the "planet" is a sophisticated 3D projection whose projector faked a body and gravity well; the projector breaks during our experiments. The planet is removed from the map; engineering research reward.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一结果。

Single outcome.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

事件图片随原星球类型变化。

The picture follows the fake planet's class.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对异常与 distar.1065（remove_planet）。30天后的通用接触报告 story.5 是共享事件，不属于本故事。

Checked the anomaly and distar.1065 (remove_planet). The generic contact report story.5 30 days later is a shared helper, not part of this story.
